name: Ice Fall Trap
source: Pathfinder Adventure: The Fall of Plaguestone
description: Compartments in the ceiling are rigged to drop a freezing alchemical liquid into the entire room if the door is opened without using the key.
disable: DC 20 Thievery check (trained) on the door allows it to be opened without springing the trap.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Fall
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The door is attacked or opened without using the key.

Effect A freezing alchemical slurry is dumped into the room, dealing 4d6 cold damage to everyone in the area (DC 20 basic Reflex save).
